risk_note: RV2 (settlement). Console writes on monthly settlement batches (CT-24zd confirmAdminSettleBill, cancelAdminSettleBatchSchedule, rejectAdminSettleBatch, resumeAdminSettleBatch, createAdminSettleSupplementBatches; 08 BR-FUND-04 ⑥ ⑦ ⑧, SB2 / SB3 / SB4 / SB8; 04 §11.2): SettlementAdminModule.forAdmin mounts the controller on the admin entry only (permission settle.bill, totp-tier step-up, audit in the same transaction as the write). Batch status changes only through the existing command service and generated transition(); no money moves here: confirmation only reaches CONFIRMED, paused_by_switch_at is kept, batch_execute is not dispatched (funds B2-04ze assembles the worker). Confirm covers every DRAFT of the bill (D10-444, production currentRound port); a supplement launch is refused while any DRAFT exists (pending_draft, D10-440) and does not write back the bill totals (D10-280 ③); a failed admin launch rolls back and leaves no settle_jobs row, retry goes by Idempotency-Key. readiness reads on the command transaction (readinessOn) to avoid a pool self-lock. AdminSettleBatch.row_version returned and required; round key at microsecond precision. x-implementation: planned removed, generated files from pnpm codegen. Two test-change commits follow row_version only (admin-settle-bills/kit.ts, frontend/admin-settle-bills/fixtures.ts; D10-437 ③), no assertion relaxed. Test-machine full verification verify/3 exit 0 (tree da4a1b0d, PROP_RUNS=2000, same tree as the head before land); verify/1 stopped at typecheck on that fixture (fixed).
